title: Marketplace update - New aircrafts & liveries in MSFS 2020 marketplace - week 16
description:
It’s April 17, 2026 and this week’s MSFS Marketplace Update (PC) is a big one with the TFDI Design MD‑11 as the headline “must‑have,” plus a full MScenery 737 Professional wave that’ll make any Boeing fan very happy. ;-)

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 MScenery: 737 MAX 7 Professional (Short‑range MAX variant for classic airline ops)
🛫 MScenery: 737 MAX 8 Professional (The crowd‑favorite MAX workhorse)
🛫 MScenery: 737 MAX 9 Professional (Stretch MAX option for more capacity)
🛫 MScenery: 737‑600 Professional (The compact classic — great for tighter routes)
🛫 MScenery: 737‑700 Professional (A staple classic variant for everyday flying)
🛫 TFDI Design: MD‑11 (Iconic trijet widebody — a true long‑haul classic)
